first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface that curves sharply left around the grass and the foot of the slope on the left in the lower part of the main image.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: Multiple silver-gray horizontal rails extending along the curve in front of the foot of the slope on the left.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white strip extending in an arc between the grass on the left and the racetrack.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The blue sky with light-colored cloud patterns in gaps in the background at the top of the main image.

entities.name: Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall
entities.identification: The continuous strip-shaped barrier wall with yellow-and-black left-pointing arrows arranged along the outside of the curve.

entities.name: White Billboard with Circular Logo
entities.identification: The billboard with a white rectangular face bearing a dark blue oval ring and red letters.

entities.name: White Billboard with Triangular Logo
entities.identification: The billboard with a rectangular white face bearing multiple black triangular patterns and light-colored lettering below.

entities.name: Gray Concrete Structure
entities.identification: The large gray structure ahead and slightly left, with a broad gray upper component, vertical components, and repeated divisions in the lower part.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: Orange text, a top rearview frame, a route map at the lower left, a circular gauge at the lower right, and green symbols fixed to the screen.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The elevated slope surfaces, slope feet, and localized rock-and-soil surfaces on the left side of the racetrack and in the background, excluding the vegetation on them.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The collection of grass inside the curve, green cover on the slope surfaces, and continuous clusters of trees in the background.
